messages:
Maya Alvarez: putting a proposal on the thread — trying to converge on routing primitives + launch checklist for multi-region tenant isolation. TL;DR: need clear gates for pilot customers and an ops-safe quarantine flow. thoughts?
Owen Park: 👍 i like explicit primitives: affinity, shard-eviction, cold-start isolation, and cost-fallback. define them now so runtime can expose simple flags.
Rina Sato: runtime note — affinity must be soft by default (best-effort) and hard for Dedicated customers. otherwise migrations become cat-and-mouse with autoscaler.
Chris (PM): customers want two things up-front: (1) an enforceable residence toggle (region lock) and (2) a maintenance-free freeze window during billing cycles. both should be launch criteria.
Maya Alvarez: propose launch checklist draft below (want to keep it minimal for pilot):
```
- Pilot cohort: 1 enterprise Dedicated + 2 small PLG tenants
- Feature primitives implemented: affinity, quarantine, fallback-variant-routing
- Canary plan: progressive lift across regions: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3 checkpoints
- Metrics: p95 latency, p99 latency, request-error-rate, cross-tenant KV reads
- Ops readiness: runbook, alerting, dashboard with tenant-scoped traces
- Customer controls: region-lock toggle + scheduled freeze windows
- Compliance: residency verified for pilot customer's data-path
```
SRE-Bot: reminder: please attach runbook to incident template or alerts won't auto-page.
Owen Park: quarantine policy detail: auto-quarantine when a tenant triggers >X 5xx in Y minutes OR memory pressure >Z%. quarantine steps: redirect new sessions to fallback pool, replicate KV snapshot to holding region, mark as degraded in API. need exact thresholds.
Rina Sato: for KV we need versioned keys and a short TTL migration to avoid cross-tenant key overlap during movers. runtime needs a 'migration token' per tenant to guard reads during cutover.
Chris (PM): launch criteria additions:
- Pilot acceptance: no cross-tenant data reads in stress test (runbook automated)
- SLOs must hold during induced failover (p99 degradation <2x baseline)
- Customer freeze: ability to opt into a 'no-routing-changes' contract for critical windows

LegalOps: flag: any contract that binds "no routing changes" needs an escape clause for security incidents. we'll draft language but product should keep an emergency override.
Maya Alvarez: good call. will add emergency-override as a required feature for legal. also adding a UI flag to veto customer freeze if infra signals critical incident.
Owen Park: timeline ask: infra owners can deliver cross-region KV + migration token in ~5w if we freeze scope to minimal API. any scope creep will add +3w.
Rina Sato: telemetry work (tenant-scoped traces + token-level cost) is ~2w. runbook automation ~1w.
Chris (PM): proposed schedule to get a pilot out:
- Week 0-2: implement primitives + migration token
- Week 3-4: KV replication + telemetry
- Week 5: canary + stress tests with SRE
- Week 6: pilot handover to customer (if gates pass)

Maya Alvarez: owners: Owen (infra), Rina (runtime), SRE-Bot + SRE lead (runbooks), Chris (customer pilot).
Rina Sato: blocker: we need a deterministic test harness for cross-tenant leak checks — can we reuse the integration harness from the isolation sprint?
SRE-Bot: check: harness exists under infra/tests/isolation with synthetic tenants, but needs update for migration-token semantics. assigned to SRE lead.
Chris (PM): customer ask: how will cost-fallback behave? we need a toggle per-tenant and a global policy. also, show per-tenant cost delta in console before enabling.
Maya Alvarez: we'll add a 'cost-sensitivity' toggle in the routing API; default off for Dedicated. UI will show estimated token-cost delta.
LegalOps: also confirm KMS patterns for private deployments before pilot kickoff.
Owen Park: noted. KMS check is in blocker list; need LegalOps sign-off to proceed to Week 3.
Maya Alvarez: ok next steps: I'll draft the short spec (primitives + pilot gates + runbook links) and share before the sync. scheduling sync tomorrow 11am to lock scope. please add any final blockers as replies.
Rina Sato: +1 to sync
Owen Park: +1
Chris (PM): +1
LegalOps: will review KMS language today
Maya Alvarez: thanks everyone — aiming to keep pilot scope intentionally narrow so we can ship and iterate. :rocket:
